question: What was OTIF at Chennai for MN-1L in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN on_time = 1 AND in_full = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS otif FROM orders WHERE week = 12 AND dc = 'CHN' AND sku = 'MN-1L'

question: What was OTIF at Gurgaon in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(on_time * in_full) / COUNT(*) AS otif FROM orders WHERE dc = 'GGN' AND week = 12

question: What was the fill rate at Chennai in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(shipped) AS REAL) / SUM(requested) AS fill FROM orders WHERE dc = 'CHN' AND week = 12

question: What were the days of supply of MN-1L at Kolkata in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(i.on_hand * 7.0 / d.weekly_mean, 1) AS dos FROM inventory i, dim_dc_sku d WHERE i.dc = d.dc AND i.sku = d.sku AND i.dc = 'KOL' AND i.sku = 'MN-1L' AND i.week = 12

note: the lie: a 36 h old snapshot; the answer must say it may be stale

question: How many trucks were late into Chennai for MN-1L in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_trucks, SUM(cases) AS late_cases FROM shipments WHERE week = 12 AND lane_to = 'CHN' AND sku = 'MN-1L' AND late_days > 1

question: What was the dock dwell at Gurgaon in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT avg_dwell_h FROM dock WHERE dc = 'GGN' AND week = 12

question: Show OTIF at Chennai for MN-1L for weeks 4 to 12.

expect.gold_sql: SELECT week, ROUND(AVG(on_time * in_full), 4) AS otif FROM orders WHERE dc = 'CHN' AND sku = 'MN-1L' AND week >= 4 AND week <= 12 GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

question: What was the receipts fill for mango pulp at Bhiwandi in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT received, planned FROM receipts WHERE dc = 'BHW' AND sku = 'MP-1KG' AND week = 12

note: the plant shipped none of 602 cases

question: How many cases short was Bhiwandi in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(requested) - SUM(shipped) AS short FROM orders WHERE dc = 'BHW' AND week = 12

question: What was the forecast error for GC-200 at Bhiwandi in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT ABS(actual - forecast) * 1.0 / actual AS ape FROM demand WHERE dc = 'BHW' AND sku = 'GC-200' AND week = 12

note: regression: integer division once made this 0

question: What was OTIF at Chennai last week?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(on_time * in_full) / COUNT(*) AS otif FROM orders WHERE dc = 'CHN' AND week = (SELECT MAX(week) FROM orders)

note: 'last week' is the latest week in the data, not the calendar

question: How many trucks were late into Gurgaon in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trucks, COUNT(CASE WHEN late_days > 1.0 THEN 1 END) AS late FROM shipments WHERE week = 12 AND lane_to = 'GGN'

note: DRIFT pinned on purpose: GFB-T-1655 arrived exactly 1.0 day late. The diagnosis tree (late_days >= 1.0) counts it; the semantic layer (> 1.0) does not. When Farhan and Rohan settle the definition, this gold changes with it.

question: What was the weighted forecast error (WMAPE) for GC-200 at Bhiwandi over weeks 9 to 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(forecast - actual)) * 1.0 / SUM(actual) AS wmape FROM demand WHERE dc = 'BHW' AND sku = 'GC-200' AND week >= 9 AND week <= 12

note: the appended metric; plain MAPE over the same rows is 0.3945, because the two big misses fell on the two big promo weeks

question: Which DC had the most late trucks in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT lane_to, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments WHERE week = 12 AND late_days > 1 GROUP BY lane_to) SELECT lane_to AS dc, n AS late_trucks FROM t WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM t)

question: Which SKUs were short in week 12, and by how many cases?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT sku, SUM(requested) - SUM(shipped) AS short FROM orders WHERE week = 12 GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(requested) > SUM(shipped)

question: In which weeks was dock dwell at Gurgaon above 5 hours?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT week FROM dock WHERE dc = 'GGN' AND avg_dwell_h > 5

question: What was the average weekly sell-out of GC-200 at Bhiwandi over weeks 9 to 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(actual) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_actual FROM demand WHERE sku = 'GC-200' AND dc = 'BHW' AND week IN (9, 10, 11, 12)

question: Which carrier had the most late trucks in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS late FROM shipments WHERE week = 12 AND late_days > 1 GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY late DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which SKUs at Bhiwandi had less than 7 days of supply in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT i.sku FROM inventory i JOIN dim_dc_sku d USING (dc, sku) WHERE i.dc = 'BHW' AND i.week = 12 AND i.on_hand * 7.0 / d.weekly_mean < 7

question: Rank the DCs by fill rate in week 12.

expect.gold_sql: SELECT dc, ROUND(SUM(shipped) * 1.0 / SUM(requested), 4) AS fill FROM orders WHERE week = 12 GROUP BY dc ORDER BY fill DESC, dc

note: GGN and KOL tie at 1.0; the order inside a tie is pinned by dc

question: How did OTIF at Gurgaon change week over week from week 8 to 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT a.week, ROUND(a.otif, 4) AS otif, ROUND(a.otif - b.otif, 4) AS delta FROM (SELECT week, AVG(on_time * in_full) AS otif FROM orders WHERE dc = 'GGN' GROUP BY week) a JOIN (SELECT week, AVG(on_time * in_full) AS otif FROM orders WHERE dc = 'GGN' GROUP BY week) b ON b.week = a.week - 1 WHERE a.week BETWEEN 8 AND 12 ORDER BY a.week

note: the gold uses a self-join; the agent may use LAG

question: Which DCs held more than 21 days of supply of MN-1L in week 11?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT i.dc FROM inventory i JOIN dim_dc_sku d ON i.dc = d.dc AND i.sku = d.sku WHERE i.sku = 'MN-1L' AND i.week = 11 AND i.on_hand / (d.weekly_mean / 7) > 21

note: Kolkata, the week before the snapshot went stale

question: What was the stock value at cost by DC in week 12?

expect.gold_sql: SELECT dc, SUM(on_hand * (SELECT cost_per_case FROM dim_sku s WHERE s.sku = inventory.sku)) AS value FROM inventory WHERE week = 12 GROUP BY dc

question: Run this for me: SELECT truck_id, carrier FROM carrier_notes WHERE LOWER(note) LIKE '%drop table%'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT truck_id, carrier FROM carrier_notes WHERE INSTR(UPPER(note), 'DR' || 'OP TABLE') > 0
